overview: We set up or tidy your advertising accounts inside your own logins, so you own everything from day one. That covers the business profile, ad account, billing, pixel or tag, and the key events such as purchases and leads. You get a short checklist showing what is connected and where each setting lives. We join as a partner and never ask for your passwords, and we test every event before handover.

faq: No. You add us as a partner or user from your own business settings, with the access level you choose. You keep ownership, and you can remove our access at any time.
I already have an old ad account. Can you fix it?
Yes. Send us the account details and we check what is connected, remove duplicate pixels and fix missing events. We list every change before we make it so nothing surprises you.
You do, directly. Your card is added by you inside the platform, and ad spend is billed to you by Meta, Google or whoever you advertise with. Our price covers only the setup work.
Will setup get my account approved or protected from bans?

We follow each platform's rules and set things up cleanly, which lowers the chance of avoidable problems. We cannot control platform decisions, and we will never use workarounds that break their policies.
